q: In Haggai, what lay in ruins while the people lived in fine houses?
quote: Is it a time for you yourselves to live in your paneled houses, while this house lies in ruins?

q: In Haggai, what does the LORD tell the people to consider carefully?
In Haggai, to whom does the silver and gold belong?
quote: The silver is Mine, and the gold is Mine, declares the LORD of Hosts.

q: In Haggai, the people earned wages to put into what kind of bag?
quote: You earn wages to put into a bag pierced through.

q: In Haggai, how will the latter glory of God's house compare to the former?
quote: The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former

q: In Haggai, to which governor of Judah did God's word come?
why: Also to Joshua the high priest.
quote: to Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah

q: In Haggai, what did God say He would make Zerubbabel like?
quote: and I will make you like My signet ring, for I have chosen you

q: In which king's second year did Haggai's prophecy begin?
why: On the first day of the sixth month.
quote: In the second year of the reign of Darius
